facts.fact: The INSD page says decree No. 2025-1095/PF/PRIM/MEF, dated 26 August 2025 per the source note, sets the attributions, organisation and operation of the national statistical system and its national statistics council (CNS), with a named chair, bureau and membership; the page itself does not name the 2021 law.
